technique_name: Tell me what a well-structured essay should contain.
description: A well-structured essay should contain an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion. The introduction should introduce the topic and provide the main argument of the essay. The body paragraphs should support the main argument with evidence and explanation. Each body paragraph should contain a topic sentence, evidence, and analysis. The conclusion should summarize the main argument and reinforce the key points. The essay should also be organized in a way that is logical and easy to follow.
